claims: NASA is targeting April 1, 2026, at 6:24 p.m. EDT for the launch of Artemis II.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
Artemis II will orbit the Moon.
Artemis II will return to Earth.
Artemis II will test critical systems for deep space exploration.
Artemis II launch date is April 1, 2026.
Artemis II launch time is 6:24 p.m. EDT (2224 GMT).
Artemis II launch location is Launch Complex 39B at Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Artemis II mission goal is a 10-day crewed flight around the Moon.
Artemis II crew is Reid Wiseman (NASA), Victor Glover (NASA), Christina Koch (NASA), and Jeremy Hansen (CSA).
Artemis II was previously delayed from February and March 2026 due to technical issues.
Artemis II remains on track for the new April target.
